g.text: GALINI · L01 · SEC08 / East middle reserve and ascent choice

Spatial prediction
Winning the Taverna north exit reaches a narrow public
porch, then either S7 or the School arcade toward S8.
Fountain Court instead reaches S5/S6. School and East
Homes keep these from becoming one undivided middle pad.
Follower / support
The arcade provides 4 m clear passage and straight
support, while F at Taverna cannot fire through School
mass. School porch depth is 4 m north of Taverna,
sufficient for passing but exposed to a push from either
ascent.
Opponent / retreat
O can defend the arcade east mouth or fall to Bell
stepside; it cannot see S7 through School. A CT yielding
this reserve territory concedes alternate B pressure as
well as upper access.
